thread:
anya: Quick RFC follow-up — we need a concrete proposal for delivery verification + operator rollback telemetry for on-prem upgrades. current notes are fuzzy.

saman: Agree. We had three goals: detect broken activations quickly, make rollback safe/automated, and capture minimal telemetry for forensic.

nina: For clarity: by "delivery verification" do we mean pre-activation integrity checks (manifest/signature), runtime probe after activation, or both?

anya: Both. Pre-activation verifies bundle integrity/signatures. Post-activation includes health probes (k8s readiness + our probe) + artifact-level checks (hashes of activated components).

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: preflight-sig-verify -> seed-checksum-match -> operator-escrow-check -> staged-activation-signal.

 dave: I'm worried about volume of telemetry in air-gapped sites. We must keep heartbeats small and preserve PII/data locality. Suggest a compact event model: one short summary event per activation attempt (status, error-code, artifact-id, op-id). Full debug logs remain local and only shipped via operator action.

anya: +1. Minimal event model: {status, activation_ts, component_hashes[], operator_id, swarm_version}. Keep this as a 1-line JSON in the activation ledger.

 saman: Rollback automation tradeoffs: automatic rollback on failure vs operator-mediated rollback. Auto rollback is great for availability but can be dangerous for partial stateful components. Proposal: auto rollback only for stateless components / cases where activation failed early (preflight or activation probe failed within X seconds). For later failures, mark activation as degraded and require operator approval.

 nina: How do we coordinate operator approval on air-gapped installs? Need an offline manifest signed by operator or a time-limited escrow token. Otherwise ops can't approve from remote.

 dave: Proposal: operator-escrow mechanism — operator signs an approval blob that gets attached to the activation. Escrow token format: base64(signer_id|expiry|sig). This allows local operator tools to append approval to activation ledger.

 anya: Additions: operator-escrow must be verifiable by the verifier binary without contacting internet. Keep signature scheme to ed25519 (tiny libs). Include signer_id mapping in local config.

 saman: Telemetry retention & sync: activation ledger is append-only and stored in /var/lib/redwood/activation-ledger. It contains compact events. Periodic compress+rotate to avoid disk fill. On network reattachment, the operator tool can push ledger slices to S3 or customer mirror.

 nina: Safety nets: if activation fails and auto-rollback is triggered, operator should get a concise remediation hint in the ledger (one-line reason + suggested command). e.g., "reason: kernel-module-mismatch; suggest: run /usr/local/bin/rw-deps --repair"

 dave: Implementation note: avoid large diffs for modelstore blobs — only include artifact IDs and content hashes in ledger, not full manifests. If we need artifact-level diffs, use a separate optional payload flagged in the event.

 anya: Ops UX question: how do we surface a "rollback button" in the operator console without network? Answer: the operator console is a CLI that reads ledger and provides a local interactive rollback command that applies the previous activation snapshot. It writes a signed rollback event back to ledger.

 saman: Timing: propose RFC patch: (1) define compact activation event schema, (2) add operator-escrow token format, (3) implement ledger rotation & push tool, (4) limit auto-rollback to preflight/early failures. I'll draft a PR.

 nina: +1 to draft. can you include example events and example CLI UX in the PR? small code snippets help.

 anya: I'll add a short sequence diagram and a sample `activation-ledger` entry. Also include a short test plan for air-gapped scenarios.

 ops-bot: action: saman to open RFC PR; due 3d.

 dave: One more consideration: make the event schema versioned (v1) so we can extend without breaking parsers.

 anya: Exactly. Use top-level `schema_version` field in each ledger entry. OK I'll coordinate with saman on the PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
